description:
Streamline your systems management

Scan, collect, and organize your on-prem Windows machines so deployments go exactly where you need them to with PDQ Inventory.
Security Enhancements
- Upgrade SQLite to 3.53.0 to remediate CVE-2026-11824

Improvements
- Changed Tree View selection behavior to allow pointer cancellation for better accessibility support (WCAG 2.5.2)
- Updated PDF report generation to conform to PDF/UA accessibility standard for improved screen reader compatibility
- Deploy: The Latest Version column in the Package Library Updates tab now shows a Convert to Standard Package button for Auto Download packages that can no longer receive updates

Bug Fixes
- Fixed dashboard text to respond to Windows text scaling and resolved menu item truncation at high scaling levels
- Deploy: Fixed issue where Auto Download approvals required the Approve Now button to be clicked twice before a download would start
